Class menuController

java.lang.Object
menuController
public class menuController extends Object
The class menuController fetches all menu items from the database, adds items to the menu, and updates items on the menu. This includes id, name, category, and price of the items. It supports getters and setters for these attributes.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      private void initialize()
      This is the initializer for menu.fxml, which executes automatically upon display. This finds and displays today’s date and the manager’s name (if it exists), and then calls loadItems() to load the items from the menu in the database.
      Parameters:
      Nothing -

    • loadItems

      private void loadItems()
      This function accesses the the database via a SQL query, then iterates through the menu, creating a row in the GUI’s table for each menu item and its attributes.
      Parameters:
      Nothing -
      Throws:
      SQLException - if it fails to load items
